props.text: Horizontal line: a pipe, cable or air line drawn left to right over a number of 24 px units, display only.
Vertical line: a pipe, cable or air line drawn top to bottom over a number of 24 px units, display only.
Corner line: a pipe bend joining two sides of its box, display only.
Three-way line: a pipe tee with a run and one branch, display only.
Line cross: four pipe ends joined at the centre of the box, display only.
Line overlap: one pipe passing over another without joining it, display only.
End point line: a pipe that ends in a terminal bar on one side of its box, display only.
Direction line: a pipe segment with a flow direction chevron, display only.
Bus: a labelled busbar or data bus drawn as a bar, display only.
